Liu — appreciate the quick turnaround and congrats on closing. Confirming we received the MAP and dataset manifest. Proposed plan and owners below (first pass):

Phase 0 — Kickoff (Jan 4):
- Goal: align success criteria, finalize canary cohorts, confirm network/KMS requirements
- Attendees: TherapiX Platform + Security, Redwood CSM/SE (Marissa / Marcus), Solutions (Priyom)

Phase 1 — Canary (Jan 6–19):
- Scope: 10% traffic to Redwood-hosted model variant in the dedicated staging VPC; duration 2 weeks
- Evaluation: latency p95 < 350ms, token error-rate < 0.5%, cost <$X per 1k tokens (we'll provide exact after kernel tuning)
- Owner: Marcus Lin (SE) to run tuning and report daily metrics to shared dashboard

Phase 2 — Migration & Training (Jan 20–Feb 2):
- Cutover plan for production routing, runbook for rollback (30-minute SLA), training sessions for Ops + Sec
- Owners: Marissa (CSM) for training logistics; Priyom (Infra) for migration playbook

Phase 3 — Post-go-live evaluation (Feb 3–16):
- Compare quality/regression against baseline prompt set and run a cost delta analysis

Deliverables I will prepare by Dec 20:
- Draft implementation workbook (redwood-implementation-draft.xlsx) with milestone dates and owners
- Canary checklist and dashboard links

Please confirm the proposed canary window and whether TherapiX needs additional training hours. If Jan 4 kickoff works, I'll send calendar invites and a brief agenda.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Quick follow-up — a few clarifications from CSM/ops perspective:

1) Canary cohorts: we recommend two parallel cohorts — (A) synthetic traffic with full telemetry, (B) a live shadow of 5% customer traffic routed to produce real interaction patterns. That gives both controlled metrics and realistic failure modes.

2) Dedicated capacity: we have a reserved Dedicated pool scoped to your commitment; Marcus will confirm the GPU mix and expected throughput before Jan 4. If you want additional burst capacity during canary, we should finalize that now so we can schedule capacity reservations.

3) Procurement / billing: Jordan — please confirm final billing contact and whether TherapiX needs an invoice before kickoff for the Dedicated reservation. I attached a mutual-action checklist that maps items to procurement/technical owners.
